title: Hisobot va tahliliy matn
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilida tuzilgan hisobot yoza olasiz: bo‘limlar (executive summary, findings, recommendations), obyektiv va shaxssiz uslub, ishonchli tavsiyalar va qisqa xulosa.

scenes.title: Hisobot va tahliliy matn
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda biznes xatlarni — taklifnoma, shikoyat va javoblarni o‘rgandik. Bugun ingliz tilida hisobot va tahliliy matnni o‘rganamiz: hisobot bo‘limlari, obyektiv va shaxssiz uslub, kuchli tavsiyalar va executive summary. Bu IELTS Academic va kasbiy ishlarning eng ko‘p baholanadigan janri — Oxirgi darsda yozganingiz yanada professional ko‘rinishga keladi. Dars oxirida 300 so‘zli hisobot loyihasini tuzib olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson three. Today we learn how to write structured reports in English: sections, an objective impersonal style, strong recommendations and an executive summary.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun ingliz tilida tuzilgan hisobot yozishni — bo‘limlarni, obyektiv shaxssiz uslubni, kuchli tavsiyalarni va executive summary’ni — o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Hisobot nima va qachon yoziladi

examples.t: The purpose of this report is to analyse customer satisfaction.
examples.uz: Ushbu hisobotning maqsadi mijozlar qoniqishini tahlil qilishdir.

examples.t: This report outlines the findings of the market survey.
examples.uz: Ushbu hisobot bozor tadqiqotining natijalarini bayon qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Hisobot — ingliz tilidagi eng muhim kasbiy janrlardan biri. Xatdan farqli o‘laroq, hisobot uzun, tuzilgan hujjat: ma’lumot to‘playdi, tahlil qiladi va tavsiya beradi. O‘quvchi odatda band menejer — u sahifama-sahifa o‘qimaydi, balki sarlavhalar bilan sakrab o‘qiydi. Shuning uchun ingliz hisobotida sarlavhalar (headings) majburiy. Ikki xil maqsadli o‘quvchi bor: ishdagi qaror qabul qiluvchi va IELTS kabi imtihon baholovchisi. Ikkalasi ham tuzilishni tekshiradi. Eslab qoling: hisobot — ma’lumot yetkazish va qaror qabul qilish uchun yoziladi, insho emas.
scenes.say: A report is a structured document with a purpose: to inform, to analyse and to recommend. It has clear headings, because busy readers scan, not read word by word.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobot — maqsadli tuzilgan hujjat: xabardor qilish, tahlil qilish va tavsiya berish uchun. Uning sarlavhalari aniq bo‘ladi, chunki band o‘quvchilar so‘zma-so‘z o‘qimaydi, sarlavhalar bo‘ylab sakrab o‘qiydilar.

scenes.title: Hisobot bo‘limlari 1: title block va executive summary

examples.t: To: Board of Directors | From: A. Karimov | Date: 9 November 2026 | Subject: Q3 Sales Review
examples.uz: Kimga: Direktorlar kengashi | Kimdan: A. Karimov | Sana: 9-noyabr 2026 | Mavzu: Q3 sotuvlar tahlili

examples.t: This executive summary presents the key findings of the survey.
examples.uz: Ushbu qisqa xulosa tadqiqotning asosiy topilmalarini bayon qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz hisobotining ilk ikki qismi. Birinchisi — title block: “To: Board of Directors | From: A. Karimov | Date: … | Subject: …” — kimga, kimdan, sana va mavzu — to‘rtta qator, biznes xatga o‘xshaydi. Ikkinchisi — executive summary — birinchi sahifadagi eng muhim bo‘lim. U o‘zicha mustaqil ma’no berishi kerak: band direktor faqat shu sahifani o‘qib qaror qabul qiladi. Unda uch narsa bo‘ladi: hisobotning maqsadi, asosiy topilmalar va asosiy tavsiyalar. Uzunligi odatda butun hisobotning 5–10 foizi. Eslab qoling: avval title block, keyin executive summary — hech qachon teskari emas.
scenes.say: Every report opens with a title block — to, from, date, subject — then an executive summary that stands alone: the purpose, the key findings and the main recommendations.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir hisobot title block bilan boshlanadi — kimga, kimdan, sana, mavzu — keyin mustaqil ma’no beradigan executive summary keladi: maqsad, asosiy topilmalar va asosiy tavsiyalar.

scenes.title: Hisobot bo‘limlari 2: introduction, findings, analysis, recommendations

examples.t: The findings show a 12 % drop in customer retention.
examples.uz: Topilmalar mijozlar saqlab qolishning 12 foizga pasayganini ko‘rsatadi.

examples.t: This suggests weak onboarding procedures.
examples.uz: Bu onboarding tartib-qoidalarning zaifligini bildiradi.

scenes.say_native: Hisobotning tanasi to‘rt bo‘limdan iborat. Introduction maqsad va doirani belgilaydi: “This report examines…” — ushbu hisobot …ni o‘rganadi — qisqa, bir xat boshi. Findings — topilmalar — faqat dalillar: raqamlar, faktlar, kuzatuvlar — “The findings show a 12 % drop in retention” — topilmalar mijozlarni saqlash 12 foizga pasayganini ko‘rsatadi — bu yerda hali xulosa yo‘q. Analysis — tahlil — dalillar nimani anglatadi: “This suggests weak onboarding procedures” — bu onboarding tartiblari zaif ekanini bildiradi — sabab va oqibat. Recommendations — tavsiyalar — nima qilish kerak. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: Findings va Analysis’ni aralashtirish — dalilni tahlil bilan, tahlilni tavsiya bilan almashtirish. Eslab qoling: dalil ko‘rsating, talqin qiling, tavsiya bering — uch bosqich ketma-ket.
scenes.say: The body has four sections: introduction sets the purpose, findings present the evidence, analysis interprets it, recommendations say what to do next.
scenes.say_uz: Tana to‘rt bo‘limdan iborat: introduction maqsadni belgilaydi, findings dalillarni ko‘rsatadi, analysis ularni talqin qiladi, recommendations esa nima qilish kerakligini aytadi.

scenes.title: Bo‘limlarni tartibga solish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Tartibni mashq qiling. Bo‘limlarni to‘g‘ri ketma-ketlikka qo‘ying: executive summary, recommendations, title block, findings, introduction, analysis, appendix. O‘ylab ingliz tilida har bir bo‘lim nima qilishini bittadan gap bilan ayting. Javoblaringizni ovoz chiqarib ayting — bo‘limlar o‘rnini almashtirsangiz, hisobot mantiqi buziladi.
scenes.say: Order the sections: executive summary, recommendations, title block, findings, introduction, analysis, appendix. Then say in English what each section does.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘limlarni tartibga qo‘ying: executive summary, recommendations, title block, findings, introduction, analysis, appendix. Keyin har bir bo‘lim nima qilishini ingliz tilida ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: hisobot tartibi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. To‘g‘ri tartib: title block, executive summary, introduction, findings, analysis, recommendations, appendix. Har birining vazifasi: title block kim va nima haqida ekanini bildiradi; executive summary butun hisobotni yarim sahifada xulosa qiladi; introduction maqsad va doira; findings dalillar; analysis dalillar tahlili; recommendations amaliy taklif; appendix — jadvallar va qo‘shimcha ma’lumotlar. Endi bu tuzilma sizga tanish — keyingi qadam: yozish uslubi.
scenes.say: The correct order: title block, executive summary, introduction, findings, analysis, recommendations, appendix. Each section has one job — keep them separate.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri tartib: title block, executive summary, introduction, findings, analysis, recommendations, appendix. Har bir bo‘limning bitta vazifasi bor — ularni aralashtirmang.

scenes.title: Obyektiv, shaxssiz uslub: impersonal style

examples.t: It is evident that costs rose by 8 %.
examples.uz: Xarajatlar 8 foizga oshgani ayon.

examples.t: The data indicates a steady decline.
examples.uz: Ma’lumotlar barqaror pasayishni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Hisobot uslubining oltin qoidasi — shaxssizlik. O‘zbek tilida “Menimcha” deyish tabiiy, lekin ingliz hisobotida “I think” zaiflik belgisi. Uning o‘rniga ikkita kuchli vosita bor. Birinchisi — “it” bilan boshlanadigan shaxssiz tuzilmalar: “It is evident that costs rose by 8 %” — xarajatlar 8 foizga oshgani ayon — go‘yoki dalil o‘zi gapiradi. Ikkinchisi — passive: “The data was analysed” — ma’lumotlar tahlil qilindi — kim qilgani emas, nima qilgani muhim. Shuningdek “The findings indicate…” yoki “The evidence suggests…” kabi ma’lumot sub’ekt sifatida ishlatiladi. Eslab qoling: shaxssiz uslub hisobotga obyektivlik va vazn beradi — dalil gapirsin, muallif emas.
scenes.say: Reports use an impersonal style: it is evident that costs rose, the data was analysed, the findings indicate a decline. Let the evidence speak, not the author.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobotlar shaxssiz uslubdan foydalanadi: xarajatlar oshgani ayon, ma’lumotlar tahlil qilindi, topilmalar pasayishni ko‘rsatadi. Dalil gapirsin, muallif emas.

scenes.title: Shaxsiy fikrni obyektivga aylantirish
board: ✗ I think we should hire two analysts.
✓ It is recommended that two analysts be hired.
✗ We found out that sales grew.
✓ Sales were found to have grown.

examples.t: It is recommended that the onboarding process be revised.
examples.uz: Onboarding (ishga tushirish) jarayoni qayta ko‘rib chiqilishi tavsiya etiladi.

examples.t: Customer feedback was analysed and grouped into three themes.
examples.uz: Mijozlar fikr-mulohazalari tahlil qilindi va uchta mavzuga guruhlandi.

scenes.say_native: Ikki juftlikni yodda tuting. Birinchi juftlik: “I think we should hire two analysts” — shaxsiy fikr — zaif; to‘g‘risi: “It is recommended that two analysts be hired” — shaxssiz passiv, tavsiya — bu yerda “be hired” — subjunktiv shakli, formal ingliz tilida shunday qoladi, “hire” emas. Ikkinchi juftlik: “We found out that sales grew” — “found out” juda norasmiy; to‘g‘risi: “Sales were found to have grown” yoki “The analysis found that…” — passivda natija oldinga chiqadi. Yana bir signal: hisobotda “I/we/you” so‘zlari uchrasa — u allaqachon shaxsiy uslubga tushib qolgan. Eslab qoling: muallif yashirin, dalil ochiq.
scenes.say: Compare: I think we should hire — weak, personal. It is recommended that two analysts be hired — formal, impersonal. We found out — informal. Sales were found to have grown — formal and objective.
scenes.say_uz: Solishtiring: “Menimcha, biz yollamoqchimiz” — zaif, shaxsiy. “Ikki tahlilchi yollash tavsiya etiladi” — rasmiy, shaxssiz. “Biz aniqladik” — norasmiy. “Sotuvlar oshgani aniqlandi” — rasmiy va obyektiv.

scenes.title: Shaxsiyni obyektivga aylantirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni shaxssiz uslubga o‘giring. Birinchi: “I believe the plan is risky” — nimani o‘zgartirish kerak — “It is considered that the plan carries risks” deb yozing. Ikkinchi: “We should cut costs by 10 %” — tavsiya shaxssiz shaklda — “It is recommended that costs be reduced by 10 %”. Uchinchi: “Everyone in the team agrees on this” — “The team is unanimous that…” yoki shunga o‘xshash shaxssiz tuzilma. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda o‘qing.
scenes.say: Rewrite in an impersonal style: one, I believe the plan is risky. Two, we should cut costs by ten per cent. Three, everyone in the team agrees. Say your versions aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Shaxssiz uslubga qayta yozing: bir, reja xavfli deb hisoblayman. Ikki, biz xarajatlarni o‘n foizga qisqartirishimiz kerak. Uch, jamoadagi hamma rozi. O‘z variantlaringizni baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: obyektiv uslub mashqi
board: It is recommended that costs be reduced…
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “It is considered that the plan carries risks” — “I believe” o‘rniga “it is considered” — hisobotlarda fikrga nisbat ham obyektiv qolib ketadi. Ikkinchi: “It is recommended that costs be reduced by 10 %” — diqqat qiling, “be reduced” — subjunktiv, zamon bilan moslashmaydi — formal ingliz tilida har doim “be” qoladi. Uchinchi: “The team is unanimous in its support” — “everyone agrees” o‘rniga jamoa sub’ekt sifatida ishlatilgan. Ikkinchisini xato yozmang — “should be reduced” ham mumkin, lekin subjunktiv yanada rasmiyroq.
scenes.say: Model answers: it is considered that the plan carries risks; it is recommended that costs be reduced by ten per cent; the team is unanimous in its support. Note the subjunctive: be, not is.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna javoblar: reja xavf tug‘diradi deb hisoblanadi; xarajatlar o‘n foizga qisqartirilishi tavsiya etiladi; jamoa bir ovozdan qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. E’tibor bering, subjunktiv: “be”, “is” emas.

scenes.title: Executive summary: qoidalari

examples.t: This report reviews customer retention and recommends three actions.
examples.uz: Ushbu hisobot mijozlar saqlanishini ko‘rib chiqadi va uchta harakatni tavsiya qiladi.

examples.t: Retention fell by 12 %; immediate action is required.
examples.uz: Saqlanish 12 foizga tushdi; darhol chora ko‘rish zarur.

scenes.say_native: Executive summary — hisobotning eng muhim bo‘limi va eng ko‘p buziladigan bo‘limi. To‘rtta qoidasi: birinchisi, u “stands alone” — mustaqil o‘qilganda to‘liq tushunarli bo‘lsin — direktor boshqa hech narsani o‘qimasa ham qaror qabul qilsin. Ikkinchisi, u eng oxirida yoziladi, lekin eng boshiga qo‘yiladi — butun matnni bilgan odam gina yaxshi xulosa yozadi. Uchinchisi, uzunligi butun hisobotning 5–10 foizi — ko‘p sahifali hisobotda yarim sahifa yoki bir sahifa. To‘rtinchisi, unda uch element bo‘lsin: maqsad, asosiy topilma va asosiy tavsiya. Eslab qoling: executive summary — hisobotning traileri, lekin spoiler bilan — chunki qaror qabul qiluvchi tayyor xulosani xohlaydi.
scenes.say: An executive summary stands alone, is written last but placed first, runs five to ten per cent of the total length, and contains the purpose, the key findings and the main recommendations.
scenes.say_uz: Executive summary mustaqil ma’no beradi, eng oxirida yoziladi-yu, eng boshiga qo‘yiladi, butun hajm 5–10 foizini tashkil etadi va maqsad, asosiy topilma hamda asosiy tavsiyani o‘z ichiga oladi.

scenes.title: Model executive summary namunasi

examples.t: This report analyses the fall in customer retention identified in the Q3 survey.
examples.uz: Ushbu hisobot Q3 tadqiqotida aniqlangan mijozlar saqlanishining pasayishini tahlil qiladi.

examples.t: It is recommended that onboarding be redesigned within two months.
examples.uz: Onboarding ikki oy ichida qayta loyihalashtirilishi tavsiya etiladi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaga qarang: “This report analyses the fall in customer retention identified in the Q3 survey. Retention fell by 12 %, driven mainly by weak onboarding. It is recommended that onboarding be redesigned within two months, with expected recovery within two quarters.” Diqqat qiling: birinchi gap maqsadni, ikkinchisi topilmani, uchinchisi tavsiyani beradi — uch gapda butun hisobot. Har bir gap aniq va shaxssiz. Bunday xulosani o‘qigan direktor qaror qabul qilishga tayyor. Sizning xulosangiz ham xuddi shunday uch qadamda yoziladi: nima uchun, nima topildi, nima qilish kerak.
scenes.say: This report analyses the fall in customer retention identified in the Q3 survey. Retention fell by 12 %, driven by weak onboarding. It is recommended that onboarding be redesigned within two months.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu hisobot Q3 tadqiqotida aniqlangan mijozlar saqlanishining pasayishini tahlil qiladi. Saqlanish 12 foizga tushdi, buning asosiy sababi onboarding zaifligidir. Onboarding’ni ikki oy ichida qayta loyihalash tavsiya etiladi.

scenes.title: Executive summary yozish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz yozing. Mavzu: “Ofis xarajatlarini qisqartirish”. Uchta gap yozing: birinchi gap — maqsad — “This report examines office expenditure…”; ikkinchi gap — asosiy topilma — masalan, kommunal to‘lovlar 20 foizga oshdi deb ayting; uchinchi gap — tavsiya — “It is recommended that…” bilan. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ingliz tilida ayting — uch gap, uchtasi ham qisqa va aniq.
scenes.say: Write your own three-sentence executive summary on reducing office expenditure: one sentence for the purpose, one for the key finding, one for the recommendation.
scenes.say_uz: Ofis xarajatlarini qisqartirish bo‘yicha o‘zingizning uch gapli executive summary’ingizni yozing: bitta gap maqsad uchun, bitta gap asosiy topilma uchun, bitta gap tavsiya uchun.

scenes.title: Javoblar: executive summary
scenes.say_native: Javob namunasi: “This report examines office expenditure for the past year. Overall overheads rose by 20 %, mainly due to energy costs. It is recommended that energy contracts be renegotiated and lighting be automated.” Sizning matningiz boshqa bo‘lishi mumkin — muhimi uch element joyida: maqsad, topilma, tavsiya. Yana bir bor eslab qoling: executive summary “I” bilan emas, “this report” yoki “it” bilan boshlanadi — hech qachon shaxsiylik yo‘q.
scenes.say: Model: this report examines office expenditure. Overheads rose by twenty per cent, mainly due to energy costs. It is recommended that energy contracts be renegotiated and lighting automated.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: ushbu hisobot ofis xarajatlarini o‘rganadi. Umumiy xarajatlar yigirma foizga oshdi, asosan energiya xarajatlari tufayli. Energiya shartnomalarini qayta muhokama qilish va yoritishni avtomatlashtirish tavsiya etiladi.

scenes.title: Kuchli tavsiyalar: specific, actionable, justified

examples.t: It is recommended that the survey be repeated annually.
examples.uz: Tadqiqot har yili takrorlanishi tavsiya etiladi.

examples.t: We recommend automating the invoice process to cut errors by 30 %.
examples.uz: Xatolarni 30 foizga kamaytirish uchun faktura jarayonini avtomatlashtirishni tavsiya qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Tavsiya hisobotning yuragidir — yomon tavsiya butun ishni bekor qiladi. Kuchli tavsiyaning uch sifati: specific — aniq — nima, qancha, qachon; actionable — amalga oshirsa bo‘ladigan — kim bajaradi, qanday; justified — asoslangan — nima uchun kerak. Forma: “It is recommended that the survey be repeated annually” — tavsiyaviy subjunktiv — formal yozuvda har doim “be + V3”. Yoki “We recommend automating…” — “we recommend + -ing”. “Consider + V-ing” ham mumkin — “Consider automating invoicing” — yumshoqroq tavsiya. Zaif tavsiyalardan qoching: “Costs should be reduced” — nima, qanday, qachon? Shu uch savolga javob bo‘lmasa — tavsiya emas, tilak.
scenes.say: Strong recommendations are specific, actionable and justified. Use it is recommended that the survey be repeated, we recommend automating, or consider revising the process.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli tavsiyalar aniq, amalga oshirsa bo‘ladigan va asoslangan. “Tadqiqot takrorlanishi tavsiya etiladi”, “avtomatlashtirishni tavsiya qilamiz” yoki “jarayonni qayta ko‘rib chiqishni o‘ylab ko‘ring” kabi tuzilmalardan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Zaif va kuchli tavsiya farqi
board: ✓ It is recommended that costs be reduced by 15 % within six months.
✓ We recommend improving response time to under 4 hours.

examples.t: It is recommended that staff training be delivered before launch.
examples.uz: Ishga tushirishdan oldin xodimlar o‘qitilishi tavsiya etiladi.

examples.t: We recommend reviewing the budget quarterly to catch overruns early.
examples.uz: Xarajat oshib ketishini erta aniqlash uchun byudjetni har chorakda ko‘rib chiqishni tavsiya qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Zaif tavsiyada uch nuqson: subyekt noaniq, miqdor yo‘q, asos yo‘q. “Costs should be reduced” — qaysi xarajat, qancha, kim qiladi — hech nima yo‘q. To‘g‘risi: “It is recommended that costs be reduced by 15 % within six months” — nima, qancha, qachon — uchchalasi ham joyida. Ikkinchi juftlik: “We think they should improve” — shaxsiy, noaniq; to‘g‘risi: “We recommend improving response time to under 4 hours” — aniq mezon. Eslab qoling: tavsiya “should” bilan emas, aniq raqam va muddat bilan o‘lchanadi — baholovchi ham aynan shuni qidiradi.
scenes.say: Weak: costs should be reduced. Strong: it is recommended that costs be reduced by fifteen per cent within six months. Weak: we think they should improve. Strong: we recommend under four hours.
scenes.say_uz: Zaif: xarajatlar kamayishi kerak. Kuchli: xarajatlar olti oy ichida o‘n besh foizga kamaytirilishi tavsiya etiladi. Zaif: ular yaxshilanishi kerak deb o‘ylaymiz. Kuchli: to‘rt soatdan kam vaqtga javob berishni tavsiya qilamiz.

scenes.title: Tavsiyalarni kuchaytirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta zaif gapni kuchli tavsiyaga aylantiring. Birinchi: “Sales could be better” — savdo potentsialini ayting — masalan, yangi hududlar va aniq maqsad bilan tavsiya yozing. Ikkinchi: “The process is slow” — sekinlikni o‘lchang — “It is recommended that…” qaysi bosqichni avtomatlashtirasiz. Uchinchi: “Employees are unhappy” — sababni taxmin qiling — “We recommend…” qanday o‘lchanadigan yaxshilanish. Har bir tavsiyada raqam va muddat bo‘lsin — baland ovozda ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Strengthen these weak statements: one, sales could be better. Two, the process is slow. Three, employees are unhappy. Write specific, actionable, justified recommendations in English.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu zaif gaplarni kuchaytiring: bir, savdo yaxshiroq bo‘lishi mumkin. Ikki, jarayon sekin. Uch, xodimlar norozi. Ingliz tilida aniq, amalga oshirsa bo‘ladigan va asoslangan tavsiyalar yozing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: kuchli tavsiyalar
board: It is recommended that southern regions be entered with a pilot launch.
It is recommended that stage two be automated, reducing cycle time by 40 %.
We recommend a quarterly engagement survey with results reviewed by leadership.
scenes.say_native: Javob namunalari. Birinchi: “It is recommended that the southern region be entered with a pilot launch, doubling leads within two quarters” — nima, qanday, qachon, natija. Ikkinchi: “It is recommended that stage two of the approval workflow be automated, cutting cycle time by 40 %” — bosqich, amal, miqdor. Uchinchi: “We recommend a quarterly engagement survey, reviewed by the leadership team each quarter” — muntazamlik va javobgarlik. Sizning javoblaringiz har xil bo‘ladi — lekin har birida raqam, muddat va mas’uliyat bo‘lishi shart.
scenes.say: Model answers: a pilot launch in the south to double leads; automating stage two to cut cycle time by forty per cent; a quarterly engagement survey reviewed by leadership.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna javoblar: leadlarni ikki barobar qilish uchun janubda sinov loyihasi; sikl vaqtini qirq foizga qisqartirish uchun ikkinchi bosqichni avtomatlashtirish; rahbariyat ko‘rib chiqadigan choraklik engagement tadqiqoti.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 1: hisobot taqdimoti yig‘ilishda
board: B: Redesign onboarding within two months.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang — menejer va tahlilchi o‘rtasidagi hisobot muhokamasi. A: “Please summarise the report in two minutes” — iltimos, hisobotni ikki daqiqada xulosa qiling. B: “Retention fell by 12 % last quarter, driven by weak onboarding. Costs stayed flat.” — saqlanish o‘tgan chorakda 12 foizga tushdi, sababi zaif onboarding. Xarajatlar o‘zgarmay qoldi. A: “And what do you recommend?” — va nima tavsiya qilasiz? B: “It is recommended that onboarding be redesigned within two months; we expect retention to recover within two quarters.” — onboarding ikki oy ichida qayta loyihalashtirilsin; saqlanish ikki chorakda tiklanadi. Diqqat qiling: qisqartirish — topilma — tavsiya — raqamli kutilgan natija — hisobotning jonli taqdimoti.
scenes.say: Please summarise the report in two minutes. Retention fell by twelve per cent last quarter, driven by weak onboarding. Costs stayed flat. And what do you recommend? It is recommended that onboarding be redesigned within two months.
scenes.say_uz: Iltimos, hisobotni ikki daqiqada xulosa qiling. O‘tgan chorakda saqlanish o‘n ikki foizga tushdi, sababi onboarding zaifligi. Xarajatlar o‘zgarmadi. Va nima tavsiya qilasiz? Onboarding ikki oy ichida qayta loyihalashtirilishi tavsiya etiladi.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: hisobotning asosiy topilmasi nima — saqlanish nechi foizga tushdi? Ikkinchi: xarajatlar qanday o‘zgardi? Uchinchi: B nima tavsiya qiladi va qancha muddatda? To‘rtinchi: kutilgan natija qachon ko‘rinadi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida to‘liq gaplar bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: what is the key finding, what happened to costs, what does B recommend and in what timeframe, and when is the result expected? Answer in complete English sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: asosiy topilma nima, xarajatlar qanday o‘zgardi, B nima tavsiya qiladi va qancha muddatda, natija qachon kutiladi? Ingliz tilida to‘liq gaplar bilan javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Asosiy topilma: saqlanish 12 foizga tushdi, sababi onboarding. Xarajatlar “flat” — o‘zgarmagan. Tavsiya: onboarding ikki oy ichida qayta loyihalashtirilsin. Kutilgan natija: ikki chorak ichida saqlanish tiklanadi. Diqqat qiling, B gaplari qisqa va raqamlarga boy — bu hisobotning og‘zaki taqdimoti: matnni o‘qimaydi, topilmalarni aytadi. Shuni maqsad qiling.
scenes.say: Key finding: retention fell by 12 %. Costs stayed flat. Recommendation: redesign onboarding within two months. Expected result: recovery within two quarters.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy topilma: saqlanish 12 foizga tushdi. Xarajatlar o‘zgarmay qoldi. Tavsiya: onboarding ikki oy ichida qayta loyihalashtirilsin. Kutilgan natija: ikki chorak ichida tiklanish.

scenes.title: Tahlil tili: dalil va sabab bog‘lash
board: “… driven by / due to / as a result of …”

examples.t: The increase was driven by higher energy prices.
examples.uz: O‘sish energiya narxlari oshishi bilan bog‘liq edi.

examples.t: This suggests that process changes take effect slowly.
examples.uz: Bu jarayon o‘zgarishlari sekin ta’sir qilishini bildiradi.

scenes.say_native: Analysis bo‘limi dalilni ma’noga aylantiradi — buning uchun uchta tuzilma yetarli. Birinchisi — xulosa chiqarish fe’llari: “This suggests that…”, “This indicates that…”, “This implies that…” — bu…ni bildiradi — dalildan keyin keladi. Ikkinchisi — sabab bog‘lovchilar: “driven by”, “due to”, “as a result of”, “owing to” — tufayli, sababli — o‘zbek tilidagi “sababli”ning professional ekvivalentlari. Uchinchisi — natija: “which means that…”, “consequently” — bu shuni anglatadiki. Yaxshi analiz har bir dalilga “nima uchun?” deb so‘raydi va javobni shu tuzilmalar bilan yozadi. Eslab qoling: dalil — sabab — oqibat — har biri to‘liq gap.
scenes.say: Link evidence to meaning with: this suggests that, this indicates that; causal phrases like driven by and due to; and result markers like which means that.
scenes.say_uz: Dalilni ma’noga bog‘lang: this suggests that, this indicates that; driven by va due to kabi sabab iboralari; hamda which means that kabi natija ko‘rsatkichlari.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 2: IELTS Task 1 uslubidagi hisobot topshirig‘i
board: A: The chart shows declining retention…
B: What is the objective tone?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — IELTS Academic Task 1 ga o‘xshash grafik hisobot mashqi haqida suhbat. A: “The chart shows retention declining from 78 % to 66 % over three quarters” — grafik saqlanishning uch chorak davomida 78 foizdan 66 foizga tushganini ko‘rsatadi. B: “What tone should the report take?” — hisobot qanday ohangda bo‘lishi kerak? A: “Objective and impersonal — no personal opinions, no ‘I think’. The data speaks for itself.” — obyektiv va shaxssiz — shaxsiy fikr yo‘q, “I think” yo‘q. Ma’lumot o‘zi gapiradi. B: “Exactly. Describe, compare, conclude — in that order.” — to‘g‘ri. Tasvirlang, solishtiring, xulosa chiqaring — shu tartibda. Diqqat qiling: tasvir — solishtiruv — xulosa — uch bosqich. Bu keyingi darsda batafsil o‘rganiladi.
scenes.say: The chart shows retention declining from seventy-eight to sixty-six per cent over three quarters. What tone should the report take? Objective and impersonal — no personal opinions. Describe, compare, conclude.
scenes.say_uz: Grafik uch chorak davomida saqlanish yetmishta sakkiz foizdan oltmish olti foizga tushganini ko‘rsatadi. Hisobot qanday ohangda bo‘lishi kerak? Obyektiv va shaxssiz — shaxsiy fikr yo‘q. Tasvirlang, solishtiring, xulosa chiqaring.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: grafik nima ko‘rsatadi — saqlanish qaysi raqamlardan qaysi raqamgacha tushdi? Ikkinchi: hisobot ohangi qanday bo‘lishi kerak? Uchinchi: A qaysi tartibni aytadi — qaysi uch bosqich? To‘rtinchi: nega “I think” ishlatilmaydi — qisqacha tushuntiring. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: what does the chart show, what should the tone be, what order of steps does A give, and why is I think avoided in reports? Answer in English.
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: grafik nimani ko‘rsatadi, ohang qanday bo‘lishi kerak, A qaysi uch bosqich tartibini aytadi va hisobotda “I think” nega ishlatilmaydi? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Grafik: saqlanish 78 foizdan 66 foizga tushdi — o‘n ikki foiz band. Ohang: obyektiv va shaxssiz. Tartib: tasvir — solishtir — xulosa chiqar. Nega “I think” yo‘q: hisobot dalilga asoslangan janr — shaxsiy fikr obyektivlikni buzadi, baholovchi shaxssizlikdan professionalismni kutadi. Eslab qoling: hisobotda “sizning” fikringiz bo‘lishi shart emas — topilmalar o‘zi gapiradi; kerak bo‘lsa, “it is considered that” bilan umumiy fikr bildiring.
scenes.say: Answers: retention fell from 78 to 66 per cent; the tone must be objective and impersonal; the order is describe, compare, conclude; I think is avoided because reports rely on evidence, not personal opinion.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: saqlanish 78 dan 66 foizga tushdi; ohang obyektiv va shaxssiz bo‘lishi kerak; tartib — tasvirlash, solishtirish, xulosa; “I think” hisobotlarda dalil shaxsiy fikr o‘rnini egallashi sababli ishlatilmaydi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 300 so‘zli hisobot rejasi
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. “Ofis xarajatlarini qisqartirish” mavzusida 300 so‘zli hisobotning to‘liq rejasini yozing: title block, executive summary (uch gap), introduction, findings (ikki dalil), analysis (sabab va oqibat), recommendations (ikki kuchli tavsiya). Har bir tavsiyada raqam va muddat bo‘lsin. Keyin ingliz tilida baland ovozda bittasini — tavsiya bo‘limini — ayting. Keyingi darslarda aynan shunday hisobot yozish imtihon va ishda uchraydi.
scenes.say: Final task: outline a 300-word report on reducing office expenditure — title block, three-sentence summary, introduction, two findings, analysis, two strong recommendations with numbers and deadlines.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: ofis xarajatlarini qisqartirish haqida 300 so‘zli hisobot rejasini tuzing — title block, uch gapli xulosa, introduction, ikkita findings, analysis, raqam va muddatli ikkita kuchli tavsiya.

scenes.title: Namuna hisobot parchasi

examples.t: Office overheads rose by 20 % year on year, driven by energy and rent.
examples.uz: Ofis xarajatlari yildan yilga 20 foizga oshdi, asosiy sabablar energiya va ijara.

scenes.say_native: Namunaga qarang: “Executive summary. This report examines office expenditure over the past year. Overheads rose by 20 %, driven by energy and rent. It is recommended that energy contracts be renegotiated and lighting automated, saving an estimated 12 % next year. Findings. One: energy costs rose 35 %. Two: rent increased 10 % in March. Analysis. These increases were driven by market prices rather than consumption… Recommendations. One: renegotiate the energy contract by end of December. Two: install motion-sensor lighting by February.” To‘liq hisobotingiz ham xuddi shu skeletda bo‘ladi — sarlavhalar, shaxssiz uslub, subjunktiv tavsiyalar.
scenes.say: Sample: This report examines office expenditure. Overheads rose by 20 %, driven by energy and rent. It is recommended that energy contracts be renegotiated, saving an estimated 12 % next year.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: ushbu hisobot ofis xarajatlarini o‘rganadi. Umumiy xarajatlar 20 foizga oshdi, asosiy sabablar energiya va ijara. Energiya shartnomalarini qayta muhokama qilish tavsiya etiladi, bu kelajak yilda taxminan 12 foiz tejaydi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Ingliz hisobotining tuzilishi — title block, executive summary, introduction, findings, analysis, recommendations, appendix; obyektiv, shaxssiz uslub — “it is evident”, passive, dalil-sub’ekt tuzilmalar; executive summary qoidalari — mustaqil, oxirida yoziladi, 5–10 foiz hajm; kuchli tavsiyalar — specific, actionable, justified. Endi siz hisobotni nafaqat o‘qiy olasiz, balki yoza olasiz.
scenes.say: Today you learned the anatomy of a report: sections and headings, an impersonal objective style, the executive summary, and strong evidence-based recommendations.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun hisobotning tuzilishini — bo‘lim va sarlavhalarni, obyektiv shaxssiz uslubni, executive summary’ni hamda dalilga asoslangan kuchli tavsiyalarni o‘rgandingiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Keyingi dars: Grafik va ma’lumotlarni tushuntirish
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Ofis xarajatlari yoki o‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda 300 so‘zli inglizcha hisobot yozing — title block, executive summary, findings, analysis va kamida ikkita raqam va muddatli tavsiya bilan. Obyektiv uslubga rioya qiling. Keyingi darsda grafik va ma’lumotlarni tushuntirishni o‘rganamiz — bugungi tahlil tili aynan o‘sha darsda kerak bo‘ladi. Goodbye!
scenes.say: Homework: write a 300-word report in English with an executive summary and two numbered recommendations. Next lesson: describing and interpreting data and charts. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: executive summary va raqamli ikkita tavsiyasi bo‘lgan 300 so‘zli inglizcha hisobot yozing. Keyingi dars: grafik va ma’lumotlarni tushuntirish. Xayr!

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda 300 so‘zli inglizcha hisobot yozing — title block, executive summary, findings, analysis va raqam hamda muddatli kamida ikkita tavsiya bilan, obyektiv uslubda. Keyingi dars: Grafik va ma’lumotlarni tushuntirish.

quiz.q: Hisobotning birinchi sahifasidagi mustaqil xulosa qanday ataladi?
quiz.why_uz: Executive summary butun hisobotni yarim sahifada xulosa qiladi va mustaqil o‘qiladi.

quiz.q: “It is recommended that the report be revised” — bu qanday uslub?
quiz.why_uz: Hisobotlarda shaxssiz tuzilmalar va subjunktiv (be + V3) ishlatiladi.

options: eng oxirida yoziladi, eng boshiga qo‘yiladi
quiz.why_uz: To‘liq matnni bilgan odamgina yaxshi xulosa yozadi.
Tavsiya aniq, amalga oshirsa bo‘ladigan va dalil bilan asoslangan bo‘lsin.

quiz.q: Findings bo‘limi nimani o‘z ichiga oladi?
quiz.why_uz: Findings faqat dalillar; talqin — Analysis bo‘limida.

quiz.q: “The data indicates…” tuzilmasi nima vazifani bajaradi?

options: kim qilgani emas, nima qilingani muhim bo‘lgani uchun
quiz.why_uz: Passive ta’sir va natijaga e’tiborni qaratadi.

quiz.q: Analysis bo‘limida dalilga qaysi savol so‘raladi?
quiz.why_uz: Tahlil dalilni sabab va oqibatga bog‘laydi.

quiz.q: Recommendations bo‘limi Findings’dan keyin keladi, chunki…
quiz.why_uz: Tavsiya dalillarsiz bo‘sh tilak bo‘lib qoladi.
